source.interpretation: MUTD=Y is the manual's mutual-dependence form. Two opposing ordinary rows are a distinct model encoding. The manual's stated deadlock distinction is a hypothesis to test against native evidence, not an assumed outcome.

variants.oneway: EXECUTE at 8.1 depends CONTINUOUS on SUPPORT at 8.0, MUTD=N
variants.mutual: one EXECUTE-to-SUPPORT CONTINUOUS row with MUTD=Y
variants.opposing: two ordinary CONTINUOUS rows, EXECUTE-to-SUPPORT and SUPPORT-to-EXECUTE, each MUTD=N

prior_diagnostics: A14-continuous-mutual-v1.0.0 same-time candidate was NO-GO: opposing ordinary rows unexpectedly launched and its event log matched MUTD=Y.

A14-mutual-stagger-v1.0.0 at 8.0/8.1 was NO-GO for its frozen deadlock contrast: opposing and MUTD=Y event logs were byte-identical. Its raw runs are retained separately and do not serve as accepted runs here.
predeclared_native_acceptance: Four fresh immutable session-0 SSH runs preserve GUI PID 13340 and the host-wide native mutex; each source and raw artifact is fingerprinted before/after execution.
All four input variants import/export every populated source business row exactly, convert with zero errors, and produce valid nonempty model, native event log and report.
Control SUPPORT starts at 8.0 and succeeds at 10.0; EXECUTE starts at 8.1 and succeeds at 12.1.
One-way SUPPORT starts at 8.0; EXECUTE starts at 8.1 and aborts when SUPPORT completes at 10.0.
MUTD=Y suspends SUPPORT from 8.0 to 8.1, then SUPPORT and EXECUTE operate together; SUPPORT succeeds and EXECUTE aborts at 10.0.
Two opposing MUTD=N rows produce the same individual event sequence as MUTD=Y in this staggered no-failure model. If they instead deadlock or diverge, this bounded equivalence hypothesis is NO-GO.

All 32 half-hour System and Stock bins reconcile with two ready aircraft at hour 16, zero failures, repairs and stock demand; native operation exposures and MTMF/STMF values distinguish control, one-way and mutual/opposing. A separate reviewer independently replays raw evidence without importing the author validator.
limits: This contract retests a previously observed boundary with a fresh pre-run declaration and fresh runs. It does not retroactively accept either NO-GO diagnostic.
Only one explicit unit, two no-failure continuous missions and a 0.1-hour stagger are covered; event equality here does not establish general MUTD equivalence or refute all manual deadlock cases.
Other schedules, readiness or resource constraints, DTTOL, GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
